Chapter 6829: Have To Kill Us First

Chapter 6829: Have To Kill Us First

Many defenders bowed at the image of the bear.

Fog appeared around the mountain next, turning it into an elusive paradise.

“This is?” Li Qiye’s eyes narrowed upon seeing this fog.

The defenders thought the fog was part of Bear Immortal’s emergence. However, Goldsilver Tree felt something was off after seeing something illusory within.

The other overlords also noticed it right away. Visual phenomena morphed and changed continuously at an incredible rate.

Suddenly, everything disappeared, leaving behind an immortal ring wrapping around the image of the bear. The other side of the ring was connected to something deep underground.

“Pop!” Only the overlords saw how this ring pulled the image of the bear into the ground.

“Still moving after being dead for so long?” Li Qiye said.

Regular cultivators had a different interpretation. They heard the roar of a bear and the pulsing immortal power, nothing else.

“This is...” The overlords didn’t know what had pulled the bear away. It wasn’t the real bear but something underground was strong enough to prevent the full activation of the remnant force.

Only a few immortals have made it that far in Golden Lamp. Mang and Zhao Dachui were part of this list.

“He’s gone.” The defenders thought the bear would protect them. However, it was all gone now.

“If there’s no immortal, time to end this.” The figure within the lightning bolt stood up, revealing his overlord aura.

“Absolute Extermination.” Goldsilver’s expression darkened as he wanted to return. However, Primal Eagle blocked his path.

“From the Extermination Branch of Fallen Ten.” Blaze said.

This overlord risked coming into Golden Lamp and being suppressed by the dao heart. However, Golden Lamp didn’t have any capable defenders currently since Goldsilver was being kept outside.

Thus, despite the suppression, he could still outclass anyone here.

As he walked closer, his aura alone suppressed everyone. He stopped by Li Qiye and said: “You have a strange presence on you, the so-called shrine must be in your possession.”

“That’s right.” Li Qiye nodded.

Absolute was surprised to see the calm mortal.

“Haha, hand it over and I will spare you.” He was amused.

“Really?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Over my dead body.” Thunder Emperor gritted her teeth and fought against the pressure. The bones in her body creaked as she used sheer will to protect Li Qiye.

“Oh?” An emperor was only an ant in his eyes: “Those from Golden Lamp are so stubborn and stinky, like a rock in the outhouse.”

“You will have to kill us first.” The other ancient ancestors fought the pressure and came closer.

“Haha, no rush, I’ll kill all of you.” He didn’t mind killing one or one million.

“Down!” Meanwhile, Primal Eagle and Gluttonous Wolf worked together, successfully sending Goldsilver back to Golden Lamp with grievous injuries.

“Kill him!” The two focused on Apexblade, the real opponent.

Depravity Abyss and Dark Emissary had dreadful wounds while holding Apexblade back just now. One had his skull cut open while the other was nearly dismembered. Nevertheless, they healed quickly enough.

Overlords were tenacious and virtually impossible to kill. Their treasures and weapons were equivalent, only complicating things.

Nonetheless, it was four against one now, leaving Apexblade with wounds everywhere despite his battle prowess.
